content: Verified via official GitHub API (2026-07-26): bwmarrin/snowflake is at tag v0.3.0, last code push 2024-07-25, 19 open issues, not archived but dormant. Clock-backwards history: issue #20 (2019) reported duplicate IDs when time goes back; PR #18 merged Go monotonic-clock mitigation for runtime wall-clock steps; PR #14 proposing an error-returning GenerateID API was closed unmerged, so Generate() remains infallible with no clock-skew signal; PR #53 (open since 2023) reports 149 duplicate IDs in a 5ms rollback test and calls it unusable cloud-native; PR #69 (open 2026-02) notes restart-time clock-backward detection is unhandled. Implication: library cannot express the deliberate clock-skew strategy (reject-with-error vs wait) this project wants.
